name: The Intimate Tattoo Parlour
body: St. Jonah's branded its girls — not literally, but the marks it left were real. Morrighan knows what it is to carry marks you did not choose, so she makes new ones. Professional chair, autoclave, ink stations organised by colour and viscosity with the meticulous care of a woman who understands that the difference between violation and devotion is consent. Every piece she inks is an act of overwriting. She keeps a leather-bound ink list — date, design, recipient, and one word for the emotion present during the session. The book is sacred. Nobody touches it without permission.
